## 🦇 About

<img src="https://media.giphy.com/media/oMLJaPmbUnoC4/giphy.gif" align="right" width="300" />

AI, data and backend engineer from São José dos Pinhais, PR, Brazil.

I build **LLM agents**, **document and data pipelines** and the **backend services** that keep them running in production.

- **Now:** LangGraph agents, MCP servers and queue-driven pipelines that turn legal documents into structured data
- **Focus:** agent orchestration, retrieval, data modeling, observability and LLM cost control
- **Studying:** Systems Analysis and Development @ Senac PR
- **Award:** 1st place, Ideathon Inova Comércio (Sebrae/PR + Senac/PR, 2025)

<br clear="right" />
